mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS cartId, p.id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.cover_image AS coverImage, p.price, p.stock, p.status, c.quantity, c.checked, (p.price * c.quantity) AS subtotal FROM cart c INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = c.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.update_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, product_id AS productId, quantity, checked, deleted, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity}, checked = 1, deleted = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, product_id, quantity, checked, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, 1, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = CASE WHEN deleted = 1 THEN VALUES(quantity) ELSE quantity + VALUES(quantity) END, checked = 1, deleted = 0, update_time = NOW()
